description: Harris County (Houston, TX) District Court new filings from the District Clerk's free daily datasets. Civil: cases filed on a day (last 7 days) with case number, court, case type, status and parties (role, name, address). Criminal: latest day's filings with case number, court, offense, bail, next setting, defendant name, SPN, sex, race, city/ZIP (no birth date or street) and attorney. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

caseType.description: Optional text filter on case type (civil) or offense (criminal), e.g. foreclosure, divorce, assault

date.description: Filing day YYYY-MM-DD among the published files (civil: last 7 days; criminal: latest day only). Default: the latest file

party.description: Optional text filter on a party / defendant name, e.g. WELLS FARGO

name: gov_harris_county_court_records
title: Gov Harris County Court Records
